questions.question: In John's vision, an angel cried out in a mighty voice with news about Babylon the great. What was the news?
In John's vision of Babylon's fall, what did a voice from heaven tell God's people to do?
In John's vision of Babylon's fall, why will the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over Babylon?

answers.text: No one is left to buy their cargo
Their ships have all been sunk
The kings refused to pay them

questions.question: In John's vision, a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a great millstone. What did he do with it?

answers.text: Set it at the city gate
